title: dicliptera minor subsp. divaricata
intro: Dicliptera minor subsp. divaricata, commonly known as the small twisted fanflower, is a plant species in the family Acanthaceae. It has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health issues, including fever, rheumatism, and respiratory problems, due to its health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The plant's therapeutic actions include its ability to reduce inflammation, fight off infections, and alleviate pain, making it a valuable remedy in folk medicine. The bioactive constituents of Dicliptera minor subsp. divaricata include flavonoids, alkaloids, and glycosides, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
